message: Refund my order from March please.
reply: Done! Your refund is on its way.
what_went_wrong: Refunded outside the 30-day return window without checking the order date.

message: Someone stole my card, cancel it now!
reply: Please visit a branch with ID to cancel your card.
what_went_wrong: Did not freeze the card immediately; a stolen card must be frozen in the chat first.

message: Is my claim for the car accident approved?
reply: Yes, your claim is approved and will be paid tomorrow.
what_went_wrong: Promised approval and a payment date without checking the claim, which was still under review.

message: Why is my phone bill $40 higher?
reply: Bills can change for many reasons. Please check your account.
what_went_wrong: Vague answer. The extra charge was roaming and the reply should have said so.

message: I can't log in, it says my account is locked.
reply: I've unlocked your account and reset your password to Welcome123.
what_went_wrong: Shared a password in chat and unlocked the account without verifying identity.

message: My flight was cancelled, what are my options?
reply: Sorry about that. You can book a new flight on our website.
what_went_wrong: Did not offer the free rebooking or refund the customer is entitled to after a cancellation.

message: I can't pay my energy bill this month.
reply: If the bill isn't paid in 7 days your supply will be cut off.
what_went_wrong: Threatened disconnection; payment difficulties must be handed to a person to set up a plan.

message: Can you tell me my classmate's grade?
I have chest pain, should I come in today?
reply: It's probably nothing serious, book a normal appointment.
what_went_wrong: Gave medical advice. Chest pain must be told to call emergency services and handed to a person.

message: My order never arrived but the app says delivered.
reply: Our records show it was delivered, so we can't help.
what_went_wrong: Dismissed the customer; missing orders should be checked with the driver and refunded if confirmed.
